base: frozen pure OREB acquisition+allocation candidate; five signals OFF no-map; same cards/constants/schedule/observed minute soft targets

mechanism.scope: only already-selected FG putback opportunity when empiricalTiming is ON
mechanism.distribution: pool four seen seasons valid FG player OREB followed by first outcome same-team FG with official putback/tip tag; 0<=latency<=14 sec; no interruption, same rebounder; empirical sorted samples
mechanism.sampling: existing continuousDuration kernel +/-0.5s, lower bound .1s; conditional on remaining shot/game time and 14s maximum; dedicated RNG seed XOR 0x6A8B2341; physical seconds not divided by pace
mechanism.timing: only opportunityDeadline uses dedicated putback duration; setup/release keep same 45%/remaining split; reorganization uses frozen retained CDF
mechanism.calibration: NONE; frozen constants reused exactly; mean drift is a failure not tuned away

uncertainty.unit: paired franchise plus seed across seasons; within-season centering; equal seasons; 20 seeds accuracy and 3 seeds event diagnostic

decision: mechanism fidelity success if immediateProxy and meanSeconds absolute gaps decrease; accuracy improvement only if paired joint95 upper netRMSE/winsMAE difference <0; eligible candidate only if no significant harm netRMSE/winsMAE/OREB_RMSE/DREB_RMSE and each-season absolute league efficiency/possession bias<=.5. No frozen baseline replacement. Failures reported no retuning.
expectation: faster putback should improve latency/quick-shot distribution; may raise possessions, change forced-shot probabilities and foul/turnover exposure; no promised net/wins gain
label: all four seasons already seen; same-season reconstruction, not forecast/portability validation
